topics.title: Blindfolds and Joan Rivers
topics.summary: During a radio segment, hosts Robin and Howard engage in playful banter while attempting to put on blindfolds, discussing their reactions to the surprising arrival of Joan Rivers as a guest. They debate her popularity, tease Regis Philbin, and make bizarre comments about ratings and potential show formats before ultimately concluding that she's an idiot.

topics.title: Joan Rivers Discusses Family and Dating
topics.summary: During a conversation, Joan Rivers discusses her dating life, expressing interest in potential partners like Brian Wilson and detailing the challenges of managing relationships with her daughters who are growing up. She also shares anecdotes about Michael Levine and reflects on past experiences with Regis Philbin, including criticisms of his behavior.

topics.title: Stern’s Frustration with Regis and Hollywood Squares
topics.summary: Howard Stern expresses his annoyance with Regis Philbin’s live show antics, particularly his autograph signings and singing of ‘Oh Danny Boy.’ He recounts past experiences on *Hollywood Squares*, including interactions with cardboard cutouts and a discussion about Joan Rivers' spending habits, shifting to an assessment of the attractiveness of men based on personality rather than appearance.

topics.title: Disturbing Deaths & Strange Events
topics.summary: This hour featured unsettling news, including the ongoing captivity of Terry Anderson and a shocking murder in New York involving a son mistaking his mother for an intruder; alongside updates on Graham Glickfield’s death from self-inflicted gunshot wound due to Tourette's syndrome. Additionally, details were reported regarding David Rochenfield and his Alzheimer’s afflicted wife.

topics.title: Milt Cayman and Hollywood Connections
topics.summary: The conversation centers on Milt Cayman’s role as a radio host’s first break, followed by bizarre claims of numerous individuals attempting to assist the host in achieving comedy success. The discussion includes outlandish stories involving violence, accusations of exploitation within entertainment, and an obsession with Frank Sinatra's declining memory, alongside references to various Hollywood figures.

topics.title: Radio Show Ramblings and Rainforest Concerns
topics.summary: A radio show features chaotic conversations between hosts, including references to past stories like drug use and bizarre dating habits. A segment abruptly shifts to a rainforest conservation message delivered by an enthusiastic announcer and his indigenous friends who appear hostile towards the hosts, culminating in unsettling interactions.
